# iru_tags (Data Source)

Look up Iru tags, optionally filtered by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iru_tags" "engineering" {
  name = "Engineering"
}

# Reference the matching ID:
#   one(data.iru_tags.engineering.results).id
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) If set, only tags whose name exactly matches are returned.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) Matching tags. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Tag ID.
- `name` (String) Tag name.
